# M9 Grain Ships (province: Kite Hill and the HOBB freight yards, Black Hole's harbour): the Aurean legion lands on the south-west road, crosses the Kite river and takes the depot airport on the plateau (depot) and sinks the three HOBB barges (barge1..3) moored in the bay by day 10. Two approaches: north over the three bridges and up the hill's gaps, or east along the south road through the freight yard and the Black Cannon's shadow. Threat/answer: minicannons (W/E/S on the depot's gaps), Black Cannon and Deathray shoot ground and sea only -> Fighters/Bombers/B Copters ignore them, Artillery outranges the minicannons; enemy AA tanks and Missiles -> player Fighters strike first, own AA and Missiles escort, woods and river banks give cover; enemy Fighter/B Copter -> own Fighters and AA; enemy Tanks/Md Tank -> Tanks/Artillery/Mechs at the bridges; Black Crystals heal BH units: kill what stands on them with Bombers. Barges (Landers on the sea): Bombers, Fighters, B Copters, or Artillery/Tanks from the shore. Player start: FTR3 BMB3 BCO2 AA2 MIS2 ART2 TANK3 MECH2 INF3 (22 units), funds 5000. Black Hole start: INF5 MECH2 TANK3 MDT1 AA3 MIS2 ART2 FTR1 BCO1 + 3 barges (Landers) = 23 units, about 1.2x the player's ground value. All inventions are Black Hole's.
